description: Validates Kustomize overlay specs for kustomization file presence, patch target completeness, duplicate resource detection, namespace-environment alignment, image tag policy, and chart ownership

rules.description: kustomize-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare base and environment

kustomization.yaml must exist at the overlay root and declare at least one of: resources, bases, or components. A kustomization with no resource declarations builds nothing and produces an empty or invalid manifest

Every patch in spec.patches that declares a target must include target.kind. Patches without a target kind cannot be matched — kustomize will fail to apply the patch to any resource and the build errors at apply time
rules.note: Skipped when spec.patches is empty or absent

rules.description: No two entries in spec.resources may share the same kind/name combination. Duplicates cause kustomize to emit conflicting manifests which kubectl rejects with an already-exists error
rules.note: Skipped when spec.resources is empty or absent

rules.description: When namespaceOverride is declared, it must contain the environment name as a substring. A production overlay deploying to a staging namespace is a correctness risk — resources land in the wrong environment with no runtime error. Set allowNamespaceMismatch: true to override
kustomize-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers
imageTagPolicy must be declared and must be one of the recognised strategies. An undeclared policy means image tag override behaviour is non-deterministic across environments
